5-8 for realism
8-10 for anime/2d

'If activating Expression Matching segment, adjust this node to start around 0.3 and end at 0.7.\nIf Expression is bypassed, this will instead send the normal frames to be desaturated, which helps organize the noise in the initial 20% of the generation.'
